text:
Marta: Quick design check 1: compact legend behavior on the metrics dashboard. Users reported legend rows collapse unpredictably when smoothing + small viewport combine. Need a clear affordance and SR reading.

Omar: Saw heatmap where legend items stacked and the unit labels moved underneath. Confusing. Proposal: reserve a fixed legend height and show a gradient fade + 'more' button.

Riley: UX: 'more' should be a button, not just ellipsis, so it's discoverable. Microcopy: 'Show all series' vs 'Expand legend' 1 — which is clearer? I prefer 'Show all series'.

Aisha: Accessibility: when the legend is collapsed, keyboard users must be able to tab into the legend and hit the 'more' control. Also update aria-live: "Legend collapsed: 4 items hidden" when state changes.

Marta: Visual hint idea: small vertical divider and a translucent gradient at the bottom of the legend area, plus a button that sits flush with the chart border. Button text: "Show all" (tooltip: "Show all series in legend").

Omar: Implementation note: don't change DOM order when expanding; just reveal hidden items to avoid focus jumps. If using a popup, trap focus in the popup.

Riley: CSS sketch:
```css
.legend-container { max-height: 84px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.legend-fade { position: absolute; bottom: 0; height: 28px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, var(--bg)); }
.legend-more { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; right: 6px; }
```

Aisha: Screen reader copy: when collapsed -> `aria-live="polite"`: "Legend collapsed: 4 hidden items. Press Show all to expand." When expanded -> "Legend expanded." Also `aria-controls` from the button to the legend list id.

Marta: Edge case: mobile small screens. Maybe make the legend a swipeable tray rather than inline. But that can be follow-up. For now keep 'Show all' primary.

Omar: Testing: visual snapshot for collapsed state, keyboard nav test to ensure tab sequence reaches 'Show all', and aria-live message test. I'll add these to the chart test suite.

Riley: Copy decision: go with short pill "Show all" with tooltip "Show all series". Tooltip must be accessible (`aria-label` or focusable).

Aisha: Also recommend announcing counts when smoothing or clipping changes scales: "Chart updated: smoothing on; legend: 3 series visible, 2 hidden." Gives context.

Marta: Action items: Omar to prototype fade+button; Riley to update copy and tooltip; Aisha to add aria-live templates & tests; Marta to add design token for legend fade color.
